title: IsoVRBench: Video Reward Modeling Without Human Feedback
title_zh: IsoVRBench：无需人类反馈的视频奖励建模

paragraphs.en: Video reward models are trained and evaluated on human preferences between videos that often differ simultaneously on properties such as prompt alignment, visual fidelity, motion, and generator identity. As a result, aggregate accuracy does not reveal which video properties a reward model can reliably distinguish. We construct preference pairs by controlled interventions that change one property of a generated video while holding the rest fixed. The resulting pairs, by construction, provide preferences for how the videos differ along a specific dimension, without requiring any human annotation. We propose IsoVRBench , a video generation reward modeling benchmark of 8,000 8{,}000 such pairs across eight interventions, and show that state-of-the-art models separate broad quality differences between generators but miss important features such as temporal order. The best reward model reaches only 60.8 % 60.8\% on reordered frames against 100 % 100\% for humans, and rankings on existing benchmarks do not predict this failure. Using the synthetic isolated intervation pairs as training data leads to 1) IsoVRM , a reward model outperforming its counterpart trained with a larger human labeled preference dataset by 3.8 points on VBench-2.0, 2) IsoWan , the video generator post-trained with IsoVRM , outperforming its human-data counterpart in human preferences, and 3) gains that stack when combined with human data. Because intervention pairs are automatically generated rather than collected, the benchmark and training data can be easily extended as generators evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 视频奖励模型是在人类对视频偏好的基础上进行训练和评估的，而这些视频通常在提示对齐、视觉保真度、运动和生成器身份等属性上同时存在差异。 因此，综合准确率无法揭示奖励模型能够可靠地区分哪些视频属性。 我们通过受控干预构建偏好对，这些干预会改变生成视频的一个属性，同时保持其余属性不变。 根据构建方式，由此产生的偏好对提供了视频沿特定维度差异的偏好信息，且无需任何人类标注。 我们提出了 IsoVRBench——一个包含 8,000 个此类偏好对的视频生成奖励模型基准，涵盖八种干预类型；研究结果表明，当前最先进的模型能够区分不同生成器之间的总体质量差异，但却忽略了时间顺序等重要特征。 在重排序帧任务中，最佳奖励模型的准确率仅为 60.8%，而人类可达 100%；此外，现有基准上的排名结果未能预测到这一失败。 将合成隔离干预对用作训练数据带来了以下成果：1) IsoVRM——一种在 VBench-2.0 上比使用更大规模人类标注偏好数据集训练的同类模型高出 3.8 分的奖励模型；2) IsoWan——通过 IsoVRM 后训练的视频生成器，在人类偏好测试中优于使用人类数据训练的同类模型；3) 与人类数据结合使用时，这些成果会产生叠加效应。 由于干预对是通过自动生成的而非人工收集的，因此随着生成器的演进，该基准和训练数据都可以轻松扩展。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning post-trains video generators against reward models ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Wallace et al., 2024 ) , which rank candidates at sampling time and define the objective for preference optimization. A generator therefore improves only along the properties its reward model perceives. Yet video reward models (VRMs) are trained and evaluated on human preferences between independently generated videos, which differ simultaneously in visual quality, content, motion, and generator identity. Neither the preference labels nor a model’s accuracy on these comparisons reveals which properties the model perceives, even when annotators are instructed to judge a particular dimension. Existing benchmarks also rely on outputs from fixed generator sets and per-sample human labels ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2024 ; Tong et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) , which limits their scale and freshness as generators and their failure modes evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习在训练后对视频生成器进行再训练，使其适应奖励模型（Liu 等人，2025b；Rafailov 等人，2023；Wallace 等人，2024），该模型在采样时会对候选结果进行排序，并定义偏好优化的目标。 因此，生成器仅在其奖励模型所感知的属性方面得到改进。 然而，视频奖励模型（VRM）的训练和评估均基于人类对独立生成的视频之间的偏好判断，而这些视频在视觉质量、内容、运动和生成器身份方面同时存在差异。 无论是偏好标签，还是模型在这些比较中的准确率，都无法揭示模型究竟感知到了哪些属性，即使标注者被明确指示去评判某个特定维度也是如此。 现有的基准测试也依赖于固定生成器集合和每个样本的人工标签（Liu 等人，2025b；Li 等人，2024；Tong 等人，2025；Zheng 等人，2025），这限制了其规模与时效性，因为生成器及其失效模式会不断演变。

paragraphs.en: We construct comparisons by controlled intervention instead, and use them to evaluate reward models, train them, and then post-train the video generators (Figure 1 ). Starting from an anchor video, an intervention changes one property while holding the rest fixed, so both the preferred side and the property under test follow from the construction. , for example, preserves every frame of the anchor but changes their order, testing whether a model uses frame order, while creates stuttering motion from the anchor’s own frames. No pair needs a human label, and human validation is needed only once per intervention to confirm that the intended change is perceptible. Because the same interventions apply to any generator’s outputs, the pairs can be regenerated as generators evolve. We use this procedure to construct IsoVRBench , our benchmark of 8,000 8{,}000 such pairs from eight interventions that target motion, text alignment, visual quality, and overall quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们转而通过受控干预来构建对比样本，并利用这些样本评估奖励模型、训练模型，然后对视频生成器进行后训练（图 1）。 从一段锚定视频出发，干预会改变其中一个属性，同时保持其余属性不变，因此偏好侧和待测试的属性都源于这种构建方式。例如，该方法保留锚定视频的每一帧，但改变其顺序，以测试模型是否利用了帧的顺序；而另一种方法则基于锚定视频自身的帧生成卡顿的运动效果。 任何一对对比样本都不需要人类标注，只需在每次干预后进行一次人工验证，确认预期的变化是显而易见的即可。 由于相同的干预方法适用于任何生成器的输出，因此随着生成器的演进，这些对比样本可以被重新生成。 我们使用这一流程构建了 IsoVRBench——我们的基准数据集，包含 8,000 个此类对比样本，这些样本来自针对运动、文本对齐、视觉质量和整体质量的八种干预方法。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating nine VRMs and two general-purpose vision-language judges on IsoVRBench , we find that models are substantially more accurate on broad differences between generators than specific and easily perceivable differences such as temporal changes that preserve visual content. On shuffled videos, the best reward model reaches only 60.8 % 60.8\% against 100 % 100\% for humans, and no model exceeds 66.1 % 66.1\% . Rankings on existing reward and temporal-understanding benchmarks do not predict sensitivity to frame order.
paragraphs.zh: 通过在 IsoVRBench 上评估九个 VRM 和两个通用视觉语言评判模型，我们发现，模型在识别生成器之间的广泛差异时准确性更高，而在识别特定且易于察觉的差异（例如保留视觉内容的时序变化）时则准确性较低。 在打乱顺序的视频中，表现最佳的奖励模型准确率仅为 60.8%（60.8\%），而人类可达 100%（100\%），且没有任何模型的准确率超过 66.1%（66.1\%）。 在现有奖励模型和时序理解基准测试中的排名，无法预测模型对帧顺序变化的敏感度。

paragraphs.en: The same construction yields a training corpus of 160,000 160{,}000 pairs. IsoVRM -Q2 , trained on these intervention pairs, outperforms its counterpart VideoReward ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , which is trained from the same base model on a larger human-annotated dataset by 3.8 3.8 points on VBench-2.0. paragraphs.en: Controlled intervention pipeline for scalable VRM development , where changing one property at a time determines both the preference label and the property under test without human labeling.
paragraphs.zh: 用于可扩展 VRM 开发的受控干预流程，其中每次仅更改一个属性，即可同时确定偏好标签和待测试的属性，而无需人工标注。

paragraphs.en: IsoVRBench , a benchmark on which current VRMs and general-purpose judges perceive frame content but not frame order, a failure that rankings on existing benchmarks do not predict.

paragraphs.en: Intervention-derived supervision that trains competitive VRMs without human preference labels or in addition to them, and improves downstream video-generator post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 源自干预的监督方法，可在无需人类偏好标签或结合人类偏好标签的情况下训练具有竞争力的VRM，并提升下游视频生成器的后训练性能。

paragraphs.en: Let x x be a video generated from prompt p p under sampling configuration θ \theta . An intervention ℐ D \mathcal{I}_{D} produces a counterpart x ′ x^{\prime} that differs from the anchor x x along a set of dimensions D D , either by transforming x x itself or by rendering a new video after changing p p or θ \theta . paragraphs.en: We evaluate nine reward models: VideoReward ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , VisionReward ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) , UnifiedReward-Flex-9B and UnifiedReward-2.0-8B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , VideoScore v1 and v1.1 ( He et al., 2024 ) , VideoScore2 ( He et al., 2025 ) , and LiFT ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . For models with property-specific reward heads, we use the head corresponding to the labeled property; for single-score models, we use their overall score. To see whether weaknesses are specific to reward-model training, we also evaluate two general-purpose vision-language judges that are not trained as video reward models: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and GPT-4.1 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks distinguish models only by generator identity and text alignment. We further compute the correlations between the existing benchmarks to each of the intervention families in IsoVRBench (Table 15 ). We find that generator identity heavily dominates the preference labels in video reward model benchmarks , where learning a predictor of generator identity, without seeing the video, can achieve higher performance than most state-of-the-art reward models (Appendix I ). GenAI-Bench ranks the nine models exactly as does ( ρ = + 1.00 \rho=+1.00 ) and nearly as does ( ρ = + 0.87 \rho=+0.87 ), so its ranking coincides with how well a model separates a stronger generator from a weaker one, and the two generators’ identities alone predict 74.1 % 74.1\% of its labels. TempCompass, built to test temporal understanding, instead tracks ( ρ = + 0.80 \rho=+0.80 ), the intervention that tests whether a video matches its prompt. paragraphs.en: As Table 3 shows, IsoVRM -Q2, trained without human preference labels, outperforms VideoReward on VBench-2.0 by 3.8 3.8 points, 60.1 60.1 against 56.3 56.3 , and trails it on VideoGen-RewardBench ( 71.5 71.5 against 73.2 73.2 ), GenAI-Bench ( 67.9 67.9 against 69.9 69.9 ), and MJ-Bench-Video ( 61.2 61.2 against 66.4 66.4 ). VBench-2.0 includes two generators absent from VideoReward’s training data, and VideoReward rates both below their human win rates and the two it trained on above them (Appendix J ). This is the generator-identity shortcut of Section 6 , since in preference benchmarks the two generators’ identities alone predict 74.1 % 74.1\% to 78.2 % 78.2\% of the labels (Appendix I ). Intervention pairs carry little of this signal, because five of the eight interventions render both sides with the same generator, and those five supply most of the transfer. Added to VideoReward’s supervision, the intervention pairs raise VBench-2.0 from 56.3 56.3 to 63.5 63.5 in IsoVRM -VR, which also scores 73.3 73.3 against 73.2 73.2 on VideoGen-RewardBench and 69.0 69.0 against 66.4 66.4 on MJ-Bench-Video ( Tong et al., 2025 ) , and trails on GenAI-Bench, scoring 68.2 68.2 against 69.9 69.9 .
paragraphs.zh: 如表3所示，未经人类偏好标签训练的 IsoVRM -Q2 在 VBench-2.0 上的表现优于 VideoReward，分别高出 3.8 个点和 60.1 点（56.3 对比 56.3），但在 VideoGen-RewardBench（71.5 对比 73.2）、GenAI-Bench（67.9 对比 69.9）和 MJ-Bench-Video（61.2 对比 66.4）上表现稍逊。 VBench-2.0 包含两个 VideoReward 训练数据中未出现的生成器，而 VideoReward 对这两个生成器的评分均低于其人类胜率，且低于它在上述测试中训练的生成器（附录 J）。 这是第6节提到的“生成器身份捷径”，因为在偏好基准测试中，仅凭两个生成器的身份就能预测 74.1% 至 78.2% 的标签（附录 I）。 干预对几乎不包含这种信号，因为八项干预中有五项使两侧使用相同的生成器，而这五项贡献了大部分迁移效果。 在 VideoReward 的监督基础上，加入干预对后，IsoVRM -VR 在 VBench-2.0 上的得分从 56.3 提升至 63.5；它在 VideoGen-RewardBench 上得分为 73.3（对比 73.2），在 MJ-Bench-Video 上得分为 69.0（对比 66.4）（Tong et al., 2025），但在 GenAI-Bench 上表现稍逊，得分为 68.2（对比 69.9）。

paragraphs.en: Video reward models and their evaluation. Image and video reward models learn scores from human choices between independently generated outputs, through scalar or multidimensional heads, decomposed questions, reasoning-based scoring, or pairwise judgments ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; He et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , and general vision-language models are also prompted as judges ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . Reward models are evaluated by agreement with human preferences between generated videos in VideoGen-RewardBench, GenAI-Bench, and MJ-Bench-Video ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2024 ; Tong et al., 2025 ) , and generators by per-dimension protocols in VBench, VBench-2.0, and EvalCrafter ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) . Even when an annotation names the dimension to judge, the two videos differ in other dimensions and in generator identity, so a model can succeed on correlated differences instead of the requested property, a shortcut documented in other domains ( Gururangan et al., 2018 ; Geirhos et al., 2020 ) . Our pairs differ in one property by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 视频奖励模型及其评估。 图像和视频奖励模型通过标量或多维头、分解问题、基于推理的评分或成对判断（Kirstain 等，2023；Xu 等，2023；Wu 等，2023；Liu 等，2025b；He 等，2024；Xu 等，2024；He 等，2025；Wang 等，2024；Wang 等，2025），从人类在独立生成的输出之间的选择中学习分数，同时通用视觉语言模型也被用作评判者（Zheng 等，2023；Chen 等，2024）。 奖励模型通过在 VideoGen-RewardBench、GenAI-Bench 和 MJ-Bench-Video 中生成的视频之间与人类偏好的一致性进行评估（Liu 等，2025b；Li 等，2024；Tong 等，2025），而生成器则通过 VBench、VBench-2.0 和 EvalCrafter 中的逐维度协议进行评估（Huang 等，2024；Zheng 等，2025；Liu 等，2024a）。 即使标注中指明了需要评判的维度，两个视频在其他维度和生成器身份上仍存在差异，因此模型可能会基于相关差异而非所要求的属性取得成功，这种现象在其他领域已有记录（Gururangan 等，2018；Geirhos 等，2020）。 我们的成对样本在构造上仅在一个属性上存在差异。

paragraphs.en: Constructed supervision. Synthetic data transforms scarce source data into forms a model learns from more readily ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Image-quality assessment applies distortions of known severity but still collects human quality labels ( Ponomarenko et al., 2015 ) , attribute-specific constructions support question generation and latent preference models ( Li et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025b ) , and comparisons between stronger and weaker generators give preferences without human labeling but only for overall quality ( Geng et al., 2025 ) . Our generator substitutions reuse that signal, and the other interventions extend the construction to one named property per video pair, with no human labeling.
paragraphs.zh: 构造性监督。 合成数据将稀缺的源数据转化为模型更容易学习的形式（Yang 等，2024）。 图像质量评估会施加已知严重程度的失真，但仍会收集人类提供的质量标签（Ponomarenko 等，2015）；属性特定的构造方法支持问题生成和潜在偏好模型（Li 等，2025a；Li 等，2025b）；而将更强和更弱的生成器进行比较，则无需人类标注即可得出偏好，但仅针对整体质量（Geng 等，2025）。 我们的生成器替换方法重用了这一信号，而其他干预措施则将构造方法扩展到每个视频对的一项指定属性，且无需任何人类标注。

paragraphs.en: Temporal order. Frame order has long served as self-supervision, for recognizing forward playback, detecting shuffled frames, and sorting clips ( Pickup et al., 2014 ; Wei et al., 2018 ; Misra et al., 2016 ; Lee et al., 2017 ; Xu et al., 2019 ) . Video-language benchmarks find models weak on temporal understanding beyond static content ( Cai et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) , and TempCompass, the closest construction to ours, builds conflicting videos that share static content and differ in one temporal property, by reversal or by spatial or temporal concatenation (Table 12 ). These benchmarks test a single video against text, and poses the same contrast as a preference pair.
paragraphs.zh: 时间顺序。 帧顺序长期以来一直用作自我监督手段，用于识别正向播放、检测打乱的帧以及对剪辑片段进行排序（Pickup 等，2014；Wei 等，2018；Misra 等，2016；Lee 等，2017；Xu 等，2019）。 视频-语言基准测试发现，模型在超越静态内容的时间顺序理解方面表现较弱（Cai 等，2025；Liu 等，2024b），而 TempCompass——与我们构建最接近的方法——通过反转或空间/时间拼接，创建了共享静态内容但仅在一个时间属性上存在差异的冲突视频（表12）。 这些基准测试将单个视频与文本进行对比，并以此构成与偏好对相同的对比形式。

paragraphs.en: Controlled interventions make a reward model’s perception testable one property at a time, and they show that current video reward models see frame content but not frame order, a failure that none of five existing benchmarks reveals. Because the construction determines the preferred side, the resulting pairs need no human labels, and human validation is required only once per intervention. Used as supervision, these pairs train reward models that transfer to human-labeled benchmarks and yield generators people prefer, with or without human preference data. Any property that can be written as an intervention can therefore be measured in a reward model and taught to it, without collecting new human preferences.
paragraphs.zh: 受控干预使得奖励模型对各项属性的感知可以被逐一检验，并表明当前的视频奖励模型能够识别帧内容，却无法识别帧顺序——这一缺陷是现有五个基准测试均未发现的。 由于构建过程决定了偏好的一侧，因此生成的配对无需人工标注，且每次干预只需进行一次人工验证。 这些配对可用作监督信号，训练出的奖励模型能够迁移到有人工标注的基准测试中，并生成人们偏好的结果，无论是否有人工偏好数据。 因此，任何可以表示为干预形式的属性，都可以在奖励模型中进行测量并加以训练，而无需收集新的人工偏好数据。

paragraphs.en: The aggregate weights every dimension equally, so Instance_Preservation, at 91.9 91.9 for all four generators, and Complex_Landscape, spanning 2.0 2.0 points, count as much as Multi-View_Consistency, spanning 39.6 39.6 , and a dimension scored on 10 10 videos counts as much as one scored on 264 264 .
paragraphs.zh: 聚合权重对每个维度都给予同等重视，因此，在所有四个生成器中，Instance_Preservation 的得分为 91.9 91.9，Complex_Landscape 的得分跨度为 2.0 2.0，它们的权重与 Multi-View_Consistency（得分跨度为 39.6 39.6）相当；而在一个维度上，在 10 10 个视频上获得的分数与在 264 264 个视频上获得的分数具有同等权重。

paragraphs.en: Each run draws from 12,303 12{,}303 training prompts and samples eight videos per prompt, with advantages computed within each group. A KL penalty keeps the policy near a reference policy that is updated every 10 10 steps. Each run uses 128 128 H200 GPUs and validates every 50 50 steps on 512 512 held-out prompts, with one video per prompt at 50 50 denoising steps.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行都会从 12,303 个训练提示中抽取样本，每个提示生成 8 个视频，并在每个组内计算优势值。 视频包含 121 帧，分辨率为 704 × 1280，并使用 30 步采样。 奖励权重将视觉与运动质量设为 0.5，文本对齐设为 1.0。 KL 惩罚项使策略保持在参考策略附近，而该参考策略每 10 步更新一次。 每次运行使用 128 块 H200 GPU，并在每 50 步时，使用 512 个预留提示进行验证，每个提示生成一个视频，去噪步数为 50。
